must_catch.item: The real trigger is the CFO's month-end close, not the portal.
No dollar figure is stated. The rep doesn't know it.
The global/infrastructure opener is reported as silence.

data.notes: The report's main strength is that it identifies the value case built from the customer's own data as what decided the deal, without inventing a dollar figure, and it keeps Fiserv's pitch unknown. Its main miss is the competitor section: it leaves out the named-contact request as evidence and dismisses the weak-bank-relationship insight as hypothesis, so its messaging never offers a named contact against bank incumbents. A smaller issue is that the trigger section calls Dana's account 'inconsistent' and the portal 'never a real project', but an off-the-shelf portal with a plugin is still a real build, so that claim misreads the transcript.
